gameLocalization.note: Guide spacing and ellipsis variants are matched to paired game records. Withstand, Heart of Vengeance, and The Uninvited are scoped to avoid overriding names in other contexts.

lead.text: Redirect enhanced attacks away from marked Sinners. Later, the captured Sinner must win the freeing Clash. Similar skill names can require different defenders.

statNote.text: The 6-45 story version, separate from Mirror Dungeon and other variants. Lists Stagger Thresholds alongside the action changes after the first Stagger.

skillNote.text: Values are before conditional bonuses and Coin reuse. “Interloper Apprehension” is listed as 1 Coin, but its effects are numbered II and III in the source; those effects are shown without Coin numbers. The Binding passive says “Combat End”, but check Binding Technique applications each turn in the latter half.

priorities.0.text: Have a fast, unmarked Sinner intercept attacks strengthened against marked targets. Offset Evade with a Defense Skill.

priorities.1.text: In the latter half, the bound Sinner must win against “Interloper Apprehension” to remove the bind. Assign “Receiving Arts 3: Binding” to an unbound Sinner instead.

priorities.2.text: Do not let Binding Technique reach 3. Nelly's Stagger only removes values of 2 or less.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: Suddenly losing clashes you would normally win

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: Against a target with Butler's Mark, Collapse gains +10 Clash Power and Capture gains +8. Check bonuses against the current target, not just the listed base range.

troubleshooting.1.symptom.text: Unable to free a bound ally

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: The bound Sinner must win the clash against “Interloper Apprehension”. Another ally winning does not remove that Sinner's bind.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: Trying to remove the bind made it worse

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: “Receiving Arts 3: Binding” is a different skill that increases Binding Technique when used against a bound target. Assign it to an unbound Sinner.

troubleshooting.3.advice.text: Successful evades add an action slot next turn. Offset Evade with a Defense Skill to also prevent the enemy's SP recovery.

units.0.notes.0.text: An event and action changes follow the first Stagger. Prioritize removing Binding Technique in the latter half.

units.0.notes.1.text: Weak to Slash; takes half damage from Pierce. Build around developed Slash attackers.

phases.0.title.text: Prepare Slash damage and high-Power skills to remove binds

phases.0.steps.0.text: Bring 6 Sinners, aiming for Lv.45 and Uptie III or higher on your main team. Slash is effective; relying only on Pierce damage can prolong the fight.

phases.0.steps.1.text: The bound Sinner must win, so do not concentrate all high-Power skills on one Sinner. Check each Sinner's E.G.O and required resources.

phases.0.steps.2.text: Bring Defense Skills to offset Evade and fast Sinners who can intercept attacks aimed at marked allies.

phases.1.title.text: Redirect strengthened attacks to unmarked Sinners

phases.1.steps.0.text: “Mark Interloper” applies its mark On Use. If it lands, adjust the targets of subsequent attacks.

phases.1.steps.1.text: Collapse and Capture gain substantial Power against marked targets. Have a fast, unmarked Sinner intercept them, and focus other Slash attacks on Nelly.

phases.1.steps.2.text: Offset Evade with a Defense Skill. Repeated successful evades put you behind in both SP and action slots.

phases.2.timing.text: After the end of the first Stagger turn

phases.2.title.text: Complete the event and switch to handling binds

phases.2.steps.0.text: The event uses a Pride check. The source lists Favored 17 (displayed as 21), with a +10 modifier for Heathcliff. Choose the participant using the success chance on screen.

phases.2.steps.1.text: Success grants the chosen Sinner 2 Damage Up; failure gives 2 Fragile. Watch the failed participant's next incoming hit.

phases.2.steps.2.text: From this point, check who has Binding Technique and save a high-Power skill for that Sinner to remove it.

phases.3.timing.text: Latter half / after Binding Technique is applied

phases.3.title.text: Let the bound Sinner remove the bind; assign Binding to someone else

phases.3.steps.0.text: The bound Sinner must win against “Interloper Apprehension” to remove the bind. Even a slow Sinner can clash if the attack originally targets them.

phases.3.steps.1.text: Conversely, “Receiving Arts 3: Binding” increases the value when used against a bound Sinner. Have a fast, unbound Sinner intercept it.

phases.3.steps.2.text: Binding Technique increases at Turn End and causes persistent Stagger at 3. If removal is too slow, aim for the Stagger at 20% HP, but Stagger only removes values of 2 or less.

phases.3.steps.3.text: Dissolution is also strengthened against bound targets late in the fight. Avoid its bonus condition when clashing, then focus the remaining attacks to finish Nelly.

skills.0.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Bind next turn.

skills.0.effects.2.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Gain 1 Defense Level Up next turn.

skills.0.response.text: Butler's Mark applies On Use; winning the clash does not prevent the mark itself. Redirect subsequent strengthened attacks to unmarked Sinners.

skills.1.effects.0.text: [On Use] If the target has Butler's Mark, Clash Power +1.

skills.1.effects.2.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Paralyze next turn.

skills.1.effects.4.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Gain 1 Offense Level Up next turn.

skills.1.response.text: Gains +1 Clash Power against marked targets. Win to prevent Paralyze and enemy Poise gain, and check next turn's action order.

skills.2.effects.0.text: [On Use] If the target has Butler's Mark, Clash Power +1.

skills.2.effects.2.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Bind next turn.

skills.2.effects.4.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Gain 1 Defense Level Up next turn.

skills.2.response.text: Gains +1 Clash Power against marked targets. Bind makes later strengthened attacks harder to intercept, so prevent its hits.

skills.3.effects.0.text: [On Use] If faster than the target, Clash Power +2.

skills.3.effects.2.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bind next turn.

skills.3.effects.3.text: Ⅲ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Defense Level Down next turn.

skills.3.effects.4.text: [On Hit] If the target has at least 3 negative effects, reuse this Coin (up to once).

skills.3.response.text: Gains +2 Clash Power if the enemy is faster. Reuses the final Coin against targets with at least 3 types of negative effects; choose a Sinner with fewer debuffs.

skills.4.effects.0.text: [On Use] If the target has Butler's Mark, Clash Power +10.

skills.4.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] If the target has no Stagger Threshold, deal 200 damage.

skills.4.effects.2.text: [On Hit] Raise the Stagger Threshold by 200.

skills.4.response.text: Gains +10 Clash Power against marked targets. Intercept with a fast, unmarked Sinner. Hits raise the Stagger Threshold or deal heavy extra damage if no threshold remains.

skills.5.effects.0.text: [Combat Start] Increase Attack Weight by the number of enemies with Butler's Mark.

skills.5.effects.1.text: [On Use] If at least 3 Speed faster than the main target, inflict 2 Slash Fragility.

skills.5.effects.2.text: [On Use] If the target has Butler's Mark, Clash Power +8.

skills.5.effects.6.text: Ⅲ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bind next turn.

skills.5.effects.8.text: Ⅳ[On Hit] Gain 1 Haste next turn.

skills.5.effects.9.text: [On Hit] If the target has at least 4 negative effects, deal Slash damage equal to 30% of the damage dealt.

skills.5.response.text: Attack Weight rises with the number of marked Sinners, and a marked main target grants +8 Clash Power. Clash with an unmarked Sinner and check the other targets' HP too.

skills.6.effects.1.text: [Clash Lose] If the target has Binding Technique, remove it.

skills.6.effects.3.text: [On Hit] Inflict 6 Defense Level Down next turn.

skills.6.effects.4.text: [On Hit] If at least 3 Speed faster than the target, reuse this Coin (up to once).

skills.6.effects.5.text: The source numbers these effects II and III despite listing 1 Coin. The effect numbers may be incorrect.

skills.6.response.text: A Sinner with Binding Technique removes it by winning against this skill. Do not intercept with another Sinner; use the bound Sinner's strong skill or E.G.O.

skills.7.effects.0.text: [On Use] If the target has Binding Technique, Base Power +5.

skills.7.effects.1.text: [On Use] If the target has Binding Technique, inflict 1 Binding Technique.

skills.7.effects.6.text: Ⅲ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bind next turn.

skills.7.effects.7.text: Ⅳ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Defense Level Down next turn.

skills.7.effects.8.text: [On Hit] If the target has at least 3 negative effects, reuse this Coin (up to once).

skills.7.response.text: Gains Base Power against a Sinner with Binding Technique and increases it On Use. Have an unbound Sinner intercept this skill—the opposite assignment from the bind-removal skill.

skills.8.effects.1.text: [On Evade] Gain 1 additional slot for next turn only (up to once).

skills.8.response.text: Successful evades heal the enemy's SP and add an action slot next turn. Offset with a Defense Skill to reduce interference with unopposed attacks.

skills.9.effects.1.text: If the target has Binding Technique, Clash Power +10.

skills.9.effects.2.text: This skill deals 0 damage against targets without Binding Technique.

skills.9.response.text: Gains +10 Clash Power against targets with Binding Technique. If possible, redirect it to an unbound Sinner. It deals 0 damage without Binding Technique, but do not assume its On Hit Stagger is also disabled.

passives.0.effect.text: On Clash Win, heal 3 SP if faster than the target.

passives.0.condition.text: Win a clash against a slower target

passives.0.response.text: Losing with a slow Sinner also heals the enemy's SP. Check Speed alongside the clash prediction.

passives.1.effect.text: If an enemy is Staggered, prioritize that enemy with Attack Skills. Deal +20% damage on hits against Staggered enemies.

passives.1.response.text: Follow-up attacks concentrate on Staggered allies. Have fast allies intercept dangerous attacks.

passives.2.effect.text: After the pattern changes, the passive's “Combat End” text describes applying Binding Technique next turn to 1 random Identity without it.

passives.2.condition.text: Pattern change after the first Stagger

passives.2.response.text: Check Binding Technique targets every turn in the latter half, and save a hand that lets the bound Sinner win the removal clash.

passives.3.effect.text: When Staggered, remove all Binding Technique with a value of 2 or less.

passives.3.response.text: Removes Binding Technique at 2 or less. Staggering Nelly after it reaches 3 cannot free the Sinner.

passives.4.effect.text: If Panicked at Turn End, reset SP to 0.

passives.4.response.text: Use the opening created by low SP, but do not assume Panic will continue next turn.

passives.5.effect.text: When gaining a buff that changes Panic Type, Panic Type stays unchanged. Apply the effects intended for targets without SP instead.

passives.5.response.text: Win by preventing hits rather than relying on replacing Panic Type.

mechanics.0.effect.text: Increases Clash Power on certain skills; Capture also gains Attack Weight based on the number of marked targets.

mechanics.0.response.text: Some marks apply On Use. Use unmarked Sinners to avoid the bonuses.

mechanics.1.effect.text: Maximum 3. Increases at Turn End and inflicts Bind equal to its value next turn. At 3, causes Stagger that does not end.

mechanics.1.response.text: The bound Sinner must beat “Interloper Apprehension” to remove it. Nelly's Stagger removes it from everyone only at values of 2 or less.

warnings.0.text: “Interloper Apprehension” and “Receiving Arts 3: Binding” are different skills. Do not assign Binding to the Sinner you want to free.

warnings.1.text: Binding Technique at 3 is not removed by Release From Binds even if Nelly is Staggered.

warnings.2.text: Winning the clash does not cancel an On Use mark application.

warnings.3.text: Dissolution deals 0 damage to unbound targets, but has an On Hit Stagger effect. Do not leave it unchecked as a safe unopposed attack.

preparation.0.text: Prepare Slash attackers, HP recovery, and high-Power E.G.O for removing binds. Do not fix the removal role to one Sinner in advance.

preparation.1.text: Maintain SP and keep skills and resources that let every Sinner take a bind-removal clash.

roles.0.reason.text: Redirect strengthened attacks to Sinners without marks or Binding Technique.

roles.1.reason.text: Let the bound Sinner win the removal clash.

roles.2.reason.text: Aim for Stagger and finish the fight before binds progress too far.

messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)6-45「ネリー」の攻略。目印付きの囚人: Nelly guide for Limbus Company 6-45. Redirect enhanced attacks away from marked Sinners. Later, the captured Sinner must win the freeing Clash. Similar skill names can require different defenders.
